applied_by_this_writer_note: control_plane.py is coordinator-owned and read-only for po03-worker-a3. The repair ships as a patch for the coordinator to apply; unit a3-u03 compensates for the defect at the guard boundary in the meantime and enumerates every path the compensation admits.
statement: path_in_allowlist normalises with path.strip().lstrip('./'). str.lstrip strips a character set rather than a prefix, so it removes the leading dot from any dot directory. '.github/workflows/po03-path-scope.yml' normalises to 'github/workflows/po03-path-scope.yml', which no longer matches the '.github/workflows/' prefix, and the path is judged outside an allowlist that explicitly contains it. check_ownership normalises identically and rejects the same paths as unowned.
observed_consequences: Every path in the commission's third allowlist entry, .github/workflows/po03-*.yml, is reported OUT_OF_ALLOWLIST by control_plane check-paths.

control_plane ingest_result raises 'artifacts outside the commission allowlist' for any result that lists a workflow file as an artifact, so units a3-u03 and a3-u04 cannot be ingested until this is repaired.

check_ownership reports .github/workflows/po03-path-scope.yml and .github/workflows/po03-clean-clone.yml as not owned by po03-worker-a3, although path-ownership.json assigns both to that writer verbatim.

The same normaliser is permissive in the other direction: lstrip removes a leading slash, so the absolute path '/workstreams/po03/probe' normalises to 'workstreams/po03/probe' and is admitted. An absolute path is never a valid repository-relative changed path, so the guard rejects it regardless of the upstream verdict.
patch_verification: git apply --check succeeds against the current tree (read-only; nothing is written).
Applied inside a throwaway copy of workstreams/po03 that also carries control/path-ownership.json, both the allowlist and ownership decisions become correct while every negative case stays rejected.

guard_compensation.scope: Admits only .github/workflows/po03-*.yml with no path separator in the leaf and no '..' segment. No other widening.
guard_compensation.reported_as: compensated_allowlist_paths and compensated_ownership_paths in the path-scope report, never as a silent pass.
guard_compensation.retire_when: path_in_allowlist('.github/workflows/po03-probe.yml') returns True upstream, at which point the compensation becomes a no-op and test_a3_path_scope asserts the patch is obsolete instead of applicable.
